title: Elliptic Sampling: Optimal Interpolant Schedules for Gaussians and Beyond
abstract: arXiv:2611.18542v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative modeling based on stochastic interpolants requires specifying two key choices: an interpolant schedule bridging the initial and target distributions, and an efficient discretization of the resulting probability-flow ODE. In this work, we introduce a new framework for joint schedule/discretization design based on the analyticity properties of the (complexified) ODE trajectories, which in turn ensure good numerical behavior. Our formulation can be solved exactly via conformal mapping, yielding a natural family of variance-preserving elliptic schedules, parametrized by Jacobi elliptic functions. Pairing an elliptic schedule with a tailored discretization, we obtain Zoloflow, a new sampling algorithm closely connected to Zolotarev's optimal rational function approximants. translated_title: 椭圆采样：面向高斯分布及更广泛情形的最优插值调度
translated_abstract: 基于随机插值的生成建模需要确定两个关键选择：连接初始分布与目标分布的插值调度，以及由此得到的概率流ODE的高效离散化方法。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个基于（复化后）ODE轨迹解析性质的调度/离散化联合设计新框架，该解析性质进而保证了良好的数值行为。我们的公式可以通过保角映射精确求解，从而得到一个由雅可比椭圆函数参数化的、自然的保方差椭圆调度族。将椭圆调度与量身定制的离散化方法相结合，我们得到了Zoloflow——一种与Zolotarev最优有理函数逼近密切相关的新采样算法。关键之处在于，椭圆调度与Zoloflow都显式地纳入了目标分布的条件数 $\kappa$，并可退化为经典的……（摘要截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于复化ODE轨迹解析性质的插值调度设计新框架，通过保角映射精确求解得到由雅可比椭圆函数参数化的保方差椭圆调度族，并结合Zolotarev最优有理函数逼近构建了能根据目标分布条件数自适应优化的新采样算法Zoloflow。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a new framework for joint schedule/discretization design based on the analyticity of complexified ODE trajectories, yielding variance-preserving elliptic schedules exactly solvable via conformal mapping and a new sampling algorithm, Zoloflow, tied to Zolotarev's optimal rational approximants and adaptively optimized by the condition number of the target distribution.
